answer.summary: No prior evidence supports intrinsic memory mechanisms beyond external validation or feature vectors in multi-turn interactions.
answer.content: Across all inspected sections of Kumar et al., 2024, no explicit or implicit indicators of self-sustaining, non-feature-based memory behaviors emerge under invariant conditions. All reported behaviors remain tied to external cues or structured systems, suggesting a gap in demonstrable internal memory dynamics beyond current architectures.
